subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw support hiding the whole status card, suppressing selected sensitive sections per agent, or retain the current always-visible `/status` and `session_status` contract?
rationale: The requested config adds public product surface and changes a tool used for time, model/runtime inspection, route context, and state reconciliation; source inspection cannot determine the intended trust boundary or whether text, structured details, or both should be hidden.

options.title: Per-agent section policy
options.body: Add one canonical per-agent status-presentation policy with current output as the default and allow sensitive sections such as usage and cost to be suppressed without removing operational status.

options.title: Whole-card toggle
options.body: Add a simpler global or default-agent boolean that replaces visible card text with a minimal acknowledgement while retaining structured tool details.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Reject new configuration and retain the always-visible status card, documenting that shared gateways are operator-trusted environments.

recommendation.title: Per-agent section policy
recommendation.body: Add one canonical per-agent status-presentation policy with current output as the default and allow sensitive sections such as usage and cost to be suppressed without removing operational status.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion records product-direction involvement from steipete, and status-path commit provenance also connects this owner to the affected surface.
